propositions: Over-triggering on any code-SHA change under UNDECLARED file_impact causes 21% of full re-reviews on byte-identical material; scoping the fail-safe to the read-set and cited paths reduces false invalidations while preserving safety.

The signed manifest must record normalized read paths from observed fetches (filtered to read_file tool, resolved against repo root, deduplicated, and existence-checked) and include a membership digest for glob patterns to detect file additions/deletions.

ADR-0002 dependency-hash machinery extends to compose read-set ∪ blast-radius entries only when all four preconditions hold: pre-existing scope is empty, container poison rule inactive, ticket scope UNDECLARED, and read-set recorded.
Read-set verification failure, pre-change attestations lacking the field, and expansion errors fall back to invalidate-on-any-change (fail-safe mode).
The basis (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) is recorded in the signed manifest and reported by plan_review_status and rebar review-plan --status command.
